caption: A block strikes an enemy that has got inside it. A 6-man enemy squad stands at the centre of a 144-man infantry block, five or six ranks in from every edge. Only a block's front ranks strike, so before this fix the men all around the squad never struck it: it fought on inside the block, and was hit only when a re-face happened to bring a striking rank within reach. Now every man of the block within reach of an enemy inside it strikes him, and the squad is cut down in a few seconds without the block losing a man.
